name: 霜枫符
subtitle: 白叶朱脉 · 霜锋一瞬
spec: A striking asymmetric maple leaf with five sharply serrated lobes, warm porcelain-white rice-paper face and fine CINNABAR RED veins, deep burgundy reverse visible only at two curled tips, tiny gold stem. One pale leaf gently hovering very low above dark floor, rotated diagonally, faint tiny shadow, NO magical circular base. Charged: leaf folds lengthwise along red central vein, edges catch ivory light, silhouette becomes slender and tense. Burst: only 4 ivory maple-leaf blades fan outward in one quick red-ink crescent with thin red vein streaks; a few maple-shaped fragments, no snowflakes or ice spikes. Original decorative orange-red falling leaves complement white armed leaf. Extremely clean controlled cream-red palette, high contrast on teal, no fire effect.

name: 墨蝶符
subtitle: 一笔折蝶 · 碎墨成风
spec: Primary charm tiny ORIGAMI PAPER BUTTERFLY as a stationary VFX charge object, not an autonomous animal or summon. Four asymmetric sharply folded wings, ivory rice paper with charcoal-ink gradient wing tips, one tiny cinnabar-red square seal near wing root, fine gold fold line. Never rounded petals, no botanical shapes, no realistic insects. Dormant: wings folded together upright like a minimal tent, very small diagonal ground shadow, no ring. Charge: four sharply faceted wings open halfway and hover a few pixels upward. Burst: wings snap fully open ONCE then dissolve into 6–8 airy ivory-and-charcoal angular paper scraps with one precise cinnabar ink arc, still local at original point, no flying butterflies that seek enemies, no giant black ink puddle. Preserve original orange-red maple tip particles. Color restrained warm ivory, charcoal, tiny red accents, old gold, beautiful ink gradation in wing tips, delicate and distinctive.
